nodes.description: SafeMath.mul(uint256 a,uint256 b) internal constant returns a*b with an overflow assert
local c holding the product a*b
raw uint256 c = a * b multiplication checked only by assert
SafeMath.div(uint256 a,uint256 b) internal constant returns a/b
local c holding the quotient a/b
raw uint256 c = a / b division
SafeMath.sub(uint256 a,uint256 b) internal constant returns a-b with underflow assert
raw a - b subtraction checked by assert(b <= a)
SafeMath.add(uint256 a,uint256 b) internal constant returns a+b with overflow assert
local c holding the sum a+b
raw uint256 c = a + b addition checked by assert(c >= a)
